name: GlzRadio
semanticRole: Choose exactly one mutually exclusive option from a labeled choice set.

material.rule: Radio controls stay solid and visually quiet. Material emphasis belongs to the containing choice surface when one is semantically justified.

input.keyboard: Arrow keys move selection within a radio group according to platform conventions; Space selects the focused option; Tab enters/leaves the group predictably.
input.focus: Focus identifies the active radio independently from the selected radio state.
input.hover: Hover may strengthen the current option boundary but never changes selection.
input.press: Press selects the option immediately when the domain permits direct choice; the whole option label row is clickable.
input.selection: Only one option is selected; selected state uses the inner mark plus programmatic checked state rather than color alone.

accessibility.name: Each option has an associated visible label and the group has a programmatic label/legend.
accessibility.state: Checked, unchecked, disabled, required where applicable, and invalid group state are programmatically exposed.
accessibility.value: Each option exposes its submitted value while the group exposes exactly one selected option.
accessibility.keyboard: Arrow navigation, selection, and group entry/exit follow established radio-group conventions.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus remains distinct from selection and follows the active option in keyboard navigation.
accessibility.errorAssociation: Group validation errors are associated with the radiogroup/legend and announced without color-only signaling.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Selection indicator swaps directly or with a short non-bouncy transition.
accessibility.reducedTransparency: No functional change required because the control is solid by default.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Strengthen circle boundary, selected mark, and focus ring.
accessibility.forcedColors: Prefer native radio semantics/system colors and preserve selected mark.
accessibility.largeText: Option labels wrap; vertical spacing expands without shrinking the radio target.

fallbacks.highContrast: Stronger boundary, mark, focus, and group error cues.
fallbacks.forcedColors: Native/platform radio appearance and semantic state.
fallbacks.performance: No advanced effects required; preserve native group behavior.

content.overflow: Labels wrap and groups reflow vertically when horizontal space is insufficient.
content.localization: Group legends, option labels, support text, and errors support substantial locale expansion.
content.rtl: Control/label order follows direction while the circular selected mark remains orientation-neutral.

criteria: Selected radio is unmistakable without becoming visually heavier than the label.
Keyboard focus and checked state are separately legible.
Groups remain scannable at compact and 200% text layouts.
Disabled and error treatments retain the selected option truth.
